written_by: paper evaluator (overseer session), from the accepted population surface and the thirty frozen questions of competency-questions-v3.1.json only, before phase two
surface: 37 record types: ENTITY 29, EVENT 2, RELATION 6; this producer routes nearly every project type through a subject-bearing source mixin, so subject-bearing types include Claim and InterpretiveClaim, Observation and ReportedQuantity, ReportedRatio, the five feature types (RidgeSection, GeologicStructure, LithosphericBoundary, LithosphericUnit, MagmaticMelt), AnalyticalMethod, Contributor, FundingAward, DataResource, PublishedWork, ResearchCampaign, RockSample, SoftwarePackage, SeismicEvent, and the relation types GeologicRelation, ScholarlyRelation, AttributedResearchRelation, CreditedContribution; subtypes on the surface: InterpretiveClaim of Claim, ReportedQuantity of Observation, ReportedRatio of Ratio, AnalyticalMethod of Method, ResearchCampaign of Campaign, SoftwarePackage of Instrument, RockSample of Sample, DataResource and PublishedWork of Source, SeismicEvent of Event, ContributionRelation and AttributedResearchRelation of ResearchRelation, CreditedContribution of ContributionRelation
method: as run-23 (E-0344): one set per question id listing the types the question is about and every surface subtype of each listed type; under v4.13 a listed subject-bearing type reaches its subject-carrying records whatever their subjects' types (SUBJECT_ANY); the carrying types E-0342 found omitted are listed where the question asks for them (Instrument on the recording-duration question, DataResource and the observation types on the catalogue question, the observation types on the crustal-thickness question); Ratio, Sample and Source are never listed as such, their concrete subtypes are; PublishedWork only where a study, repository or publication record is asked; SeismicEvent where the question is about earthquakes as occurrences; MagmaticMelt on the melt questions since this surface makes the melt a record; Evidence where an evidence relation is asked; the run-23 translations map one to one (GeologicFeature to RidgeSection and GeologicStructure, ReferencedWork to PublishedWork or DataResource, ElementRatio to ReportedRatio, RockSampleSet to RockSample, NumericalModel to AnalyticalMethod, ResearchAgent to Contributor)
